Name: Shem
Role: Son of Noah; Ancestor of Abraham
Summary: Shem was one of Noah's three sons and the ancestor of the Semitic peoples, including Abraham. Noah blessed him, saying the Lord would be the God of Shem.
KeyStory: After the flood, Shem and Japheth walked backward with a garment to cover their father's shame without looking on him. Through Shem's line came Abraham, Israel, and ultimately Jesus.
LifeLesson: Shem honoured his father when it cost him dignity to do so. Quiet, honouring choices in private moments are often the ones God weaves into His largest promises.
